g.text: 37 rules: met 21, not met 8, less often 1, no difference detected 2, not tested 2, pending 3. A minus B is a difference in percentage

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: points with its 95% interval, clustered by paused step (by task for fresh episodes and whole runs). Above 0, below 0 and excludes 0 are

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: conditions on that interval (above 0 where a row gives none); the number in parentheses is the pre-registration. Unless a row names

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: another outcome, it is that the next call reads a neighbor's code (first four groups) or that the agent is shown a line the fix changes (last

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: two). Not tested: the rule's own precondition failed; bare names were not followed, and with the instruction the true entry was read in

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: 0.34% of replays where the rule asks for 5%. The rule marked "see note" is not met under a wider recount, in which a second scorer

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: also credits a recursive search of a directory that holds the neighbor's file (+0.77 [−0.52, 2.06]). The rewired-list rule is counted once, as

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: registered. Gates and full wordings are in Appendix A.
